shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "for file in app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx app/globals.css lib/products.ts; do printf '\\nFILE %s\\n' \""'$file"; cat "$file"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const r=require('react'); console.log(r.version, r.ViewTransition, r.unstable_ViewTransition);\" && sed -n '505,540p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md && rg -n 'react.*19|react-dom' node_modules/next/package.json | head -30"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- package.json && npm view react version && npm view react-dom version'
/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const r=require('react'); console.log(r.version, typeof r.ViewTransition, typeof r.addTransitionType)\" && git diff --stat && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/ProductGrid.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css package.json && git diff -- tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc "which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome playwright 2>/dev/null || true; rg --files node_modules | rg '/(playwright|puppeteer)(-core)?/' | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'whoami && id -u && which apt-get || true && ls /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libnspr4.so /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libnspr4.so 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --check && rg -n 'react|react-dom' package.json | head -10"
/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsS http://localhost:3100/product/classic-sneakers | rg -o 'Back to products|Classic Sneakers|product-hero|product-description|Timeless design meets everyday comfort' | head -15"

/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
gallery_build_tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/product-gallery-build.XXXXXX)
mv .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo "$gallery_build_tmp"/
git diff --check
git status --short'
